caveat: Sample, cohort and daily actives are three different numbers and are routinely mixed. 849,267 is the live all-partners cohort (782,577 is a stale snapshot still circulating), ~150,300 is average DAU, 425,561 is the creator cohort, and researched personas are 26-162 people each. Any claim quoting one as another is wrong.
statement: The partner cohort is 849,267 as of 12 Oct 2026; briefs still quote 782,577, and average daily active partners is roughly 150,300.
